'''Balaro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] for [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], Balaro was stationed on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] of the Imperial Fleet.
